about: admin-visibility-plan r1h §1.8 and §7 T8: every request and response of the 2FA handoff and the admin check, between the Sagebrush site Worker and cocalc.ai. The cocalc.ai PR carries a byte-identical copy; each side's tests pin this file's sha256.

approves_only_when: a signed-in cocalc.ai browser session, not an impersonation
the account exists, is not deleted and is an admin (both routing paths)
that session's factor_verified_at is within the last 600 s (else cocalc.ai's recent-2FA step first)
records_with_the_code: an opaque, account-bound, single-use home-bay approval reference; the browser-readable approval proof carries only this reference, never session facts
records_on_the_home_bay: the approving account, session hash and factor_verified_at remain server-side in sagebrush_admin_approvals; token exchange atomically consumes the reference on that account's home bay before rechecking live session state and minting a grant

token.single_use: the code is consumed atomically (UPDATE ... SET used_at = NOW() WHERE code_hash = $1 AND used_at IS NULL RETURNING ...); a second redemption is refused

admin_grant.grant_id: string, random and opaque, [A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,200}, never a session hash or cookie
admin_grant.expires_at: integer seconds: floor(min(factor_verified_at + 600, the session's expire, the session's fresh_auth_until))

no_grant_when: any approval condition no longer holds

endpoint.get: 405 Method Not Allowed; grant identifiers never appear in the request URL

grant.expires_at: integer seconds: step 4's formula from the session's values now, capped at the grant's issued expires_at

grant_answer_only_when: the account is a non-deleted admin with 2FA on
the grant exists, for that account
its cocalc.ai session is not revoked or expired
that session's factor_verified_at is still the granted one
that session's fresh_auth_until is not NULL and now < fresh_auth_until
